profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Raytheon
profile.summary: Software Engineer with 7+ years of experience developing mission-critical software for the defense industry. Experienced in C++ software development, distributed systems integration, embedded systems, and interoperability solutions for complex aerospace and defense programs. Skilled in designing software architectures, developing interface mappings and protocol translations, performing integration and verification testing, and collaborating across multidisciplinary engineering teams. Passionate about solving complex technical challenges, mentoring engineers, and building reliable, high-quality software.

positions.title: Student Independent Research Internship (SIRI)
positions.description:
Primary task was the data reduction for absolute reflectivity and assignment of geometry. The programs are written in the Interactive Data Language (IDL). Examined the data to determine properties of the clouds in Jupiter, e.g. thickness and vertical location, brightness of particles, and particle size, using a FORTRAN-based code. 

http://adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015AGUFM.P41B2067O
positions.insights: Skills: Data Analysis · Communication · Technical Presentations

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Performed theoretical calculations of non-radial oscillations of neutron stars, and successfully derived perturbation equations for fluid oscillations in the case of the core and crust of a neutron star. Assisted by adviser with checking limits of equations, and contributed to his research on gravitational waves.

projects.title: Falcon Engine
projects.description: A Search Engine written in Java using a JavaFX GUI. This search engine was written in iterations as can be observed in the commits and the files, but the final product accepts a corpus of JSON files to build a searchable on-disk index. Both boolean and ranked retrieval are supported, in addition to the following special features: wildcard queries (using KGram indexing), spelling correction, and NEAR retrieval. Unit testing performed using JUnit.
